05 / A WAY THROUGH

Stay curious.
Get specific.

Good work starts with a better understanding of the problem.

01

Observe

+

Start with the person, the symptom and what changed. Listen before deciding where the fault lives.

02

Isolate

+

Follow the signal through dependencies. Separate the symptom from the component or service causing it.

03

Repair

+

Work at the appropriate scale: a configuration, a connection, a deployment, a replacement or a board.

04

Verify

+

Check the result, document the useful detail, and make the next investigation easier.

07 / FIELD JOURNAL

Things I keep
coming back to.

NOTE / 01

A route is a story.

Networks are easier to understand when the path is visible: entry, policy, switching, service and return.

NOTE / 02

The physical matters.

Cabling, power, thermal behavior and a component’s condition belong in the same investigation as the logs.

NOTE / 03

Leave a useful trail.

Documentation and clear communication help the next person understand the system and the work.
